affiliates.name: WIAL Canada
affiliates.aboutHtml:
WIAL-Canada is committed to helping organizations across Canada improve their competitive advantage through the implementation of Action Learning. Our unique approach is to help each functional area within your organization identify and solve its' important problems for the benefit of each employee, the department teams, and the organization as a whole.  As a result of training your diverse management team in the use of Action Learning for complex problem solving, your company will become more integrated with greater group cohesion, and will also develop more respect and trust, one for the other, Enhancing leadership capabilities is another important outcome delivered through Action Learning. 

As Country Director of WIAL-Canada, my background includes not only teaching the latest trends in OD, Management Concepts, culture, creativity and much more, but I also have 'hands on' experience in automotive manufacturing, IT, Financial and education sector. This means, we can relate to and understand many of the issues you face, as well as the nuances within the business environment here in Canada. Our success includes helping organizations both for profit, non profit, government, and in the education sector with complex problem solving, strategic planning initiatives and the development of their business and marketing plans .   

Improve your competitive advantage and move from transactional to transformational training and thus create an organizational culture of inquiry. Contact WIAL-Canada. Give us one day, we will change the way you work forever!

affiliates.name: WIAL Italy
affiliates.aboutHtml:
The World Institute for Action Learning has a Leadership Opportunity in Italy as a WIAL Affiliate.

What do Affiliates do?

An Affiliate is an organization approved by WIAL to promote WIAL Action Learning in a specific geographic region. The goal of Affiliates is to grow WIAL in the country in which it operates; advancing Action Learning. You can find out more at http://wial.org/become-an-affiliate.

Who is the World Institute for Action LearningI [WIAL]?

The World Institute for Action Learning (WIAL) is the only certifying body for Action Learning, providing various training & certification programs internationally. It is a rapidly growing international not-for-profit organization supported by WIAL Affiliates around the world. You can find out more about WIAL at http://wial.org/about-wial.

If you are interested in a Leadership Opportunity with the World Institute for Action Learning, we encourage you to contact us to explore what it takes to lead a WIAL Team of Certified Action Learning Coaches in your country.  We hope to here from you soon.

Bea Carson, President

World Institute for Action Learning

affiliates.aboutHtml:
"WIAL Singapore has quickly become one of the top WIAL affiliates in the world, growing from 0 CALCs in 2006 to over 50 CALCs in 2016.

 Based upon the quality of his training and coaching within Singapore and his worldwide leadership in action learning, WIAL-Singapore’s Managing Director, Ng Choon Seng, has been recognized as a Master Action Learning Coach (MALC), the first person in Asia to be receive this honor. As a MALC, Choon Seng has been instrumental in training and developing coaches throughout Asia, including countries like China, Taiwan, Korea, Thailand, Hong Kong Philippines and Malaysia."

Dr Michael Marquardt,  Chairman of the Board of Advisors, WIAL.

affiliates.name: WIAL Thailand
affiliates.aboutHtml:
We support leaders by working with their teams to make them more effective. Teams work together on a real business challenge, and jointly propose solutions to the leader. At the same time, team members work on their personal leadership development priority, and strengthen the team dynamic. From one session to the next, the team connects better and at a deeper level than the traditional team building approaches.

The effects of the sessions go beyond the small team because participants take actions in between the sessions, practice their leadership development priority with their own team, and test out the learnings from the session in their daily work.
affiliates.credentials: We started the Thailand WIAL affiliate in 2013 and I became WIAL Master Action Learning Coach in 2017. WIAL Thailand has run more than 20 public Foundations in Action Learning workshops in Thailand and Vietnam, several customized in-house Foundations in Action Learning workshops (Decathlon, Thairung, Metropolitan Electricity Authority, Transitions Optical), and 4 public WIAL coach certification programs.
